title: Chapter 174: Collecting The Treasure Map
content:
Chapter 174: Collecting The Treasure Map

After collecting all the property, Wang Shuo got the exact amount of supplies.

[Soul Crystal +200, Energy Crystal +10,000, Gold Coin +80,000]

A few other resources, and some animals such as pigs, sheep, and cows that can be raised in the backyard.

Wang Shuo's face was full of smiles.

He was worried about his own farm, and there were no animals to raise. Now he finally filled this gap.

Then he came to the core of the mountain stronghold, and after a series of attacks, he finally consumed the durability.

At this time, the system prompt sounded.

[You have broken through Qingmu Village, you can choose to occupy or destroy it. ]

Wang Shuo stopped his hand and read the instructions carefully.

[After destroying it, you can get a silver village building order; after choosing to occupy it, you can refresh 20 bandits every day. ]

Wang Shuo fell into deep thought and carefully considered the pros and cons.

After thinking for a while, he saw Jiang Yingyu in the distance, and his eyes lit up.

It would be better to let him stay in the mountain stronghold, so that he can increase 20 troops every day.

"Jiang Yingyu, I now appoint you as the leader of Qingmu Village. Do you want to manage this place for me?" Wang Shuo walked over and stared at Jiang Yingyu and said in deep thought.

"I am willing."

He was stunned for a while, then he knelt down and bowed to Wang Shuo.

Jiang Yingyu didn't expect that such a good thing would happen to him.

He could only think that his efforts must have moved Lord Zak, so that he could go from a small mountain thief to a mountain king in one day.

Although there is still a master above him, he is still one man above ten thousand people.

"Do a good job. When our territory develops well in the future, we will not treat you unfairly." Wang Shuo patted him on the shoulder and encouraged him.

After leaving a certain amount of living supplies, Wang Shuo returned to the village with his subordinates.

...

Fengze Village.

Zhao Tianze fled back to the village with dozens of defeated soldiers.

Along the way, his subjects saw Zhao Tianze's embarrassed appearance and their expressions were very rich.

Most of them were forced to join the village, and they had no sense of belonging, so their loyalty was naturally not high.

However, due to Zhao Tianze's power, they did not point fingers.

But Zhao Tianze still felt a kind of mockery from their eyes.

"What are you looking at? Do your own thing. If you fail to complete the task, you will not have food tonight." Zhao Tianze scolded the people around him.

Back to the lord's mansion, he sat on the throne and smashed a tea bowl.

"Wang Shuo, I swear I will not be a human if I don't take revenge!" He roared hysterically.

The soldiers who followed him were frightened and shuddered.

"Since you like to use cavalry, then I will train more soldiers to restrain cavalry, and see what you will do?" Zhao Tianze frowned and said to one of his soldiers, "Go call Commander Liu to intensify the training of spearmen."

After that, he came to a secret room and looked at a statue and studied it seriously.

His fighting spirit was rekindled in his heart. Perhaps, this thing is his hope for a comeback.

At this time, the battle of Nanshanji finally came to an end.

The tragic battlefield was full of corpses, and it was more intense than Wang Shuo's battle.

There were more than 2,000 people participating in the battle.

The final result of the battle was that both sides suffered losses and there was no winner.

The forces of the parties temporarily reached a settlement because no one could afford the cost of another fight.

The Iron Sword Gate occupied an area in the west of Nanshanji, while the east was controlled by other large and small gangs.

As for the core area of Nanshanji, all the new players did not know what was going on inside because they had never been in.

Maybe some players from outside the domain knew, but no one told the secret.

Even Ni Wu did not take any action against the core area, and other gangs had no idea.
